answer_prose: After a slow first 5 km, runners accelerating by more than 5% in the next section had a median finish 7.0% slower than their prior benchmark, versus 18.3% slower among those with little acceleration or further slowing. These groups were not otherwise matched.
detail_prose: A slow opening could reflect restraint, terrain or crowding. The available splits cannot identify the cause.

charts.title: Finish outcomes after a slow start
charts.note: Percentiles describe individual outcomes. Negative is faster than the prior benchmark.
